title: Viruses and bacteria collapse the bloom
titulo: The alliance that topples a bloom
resumen: Weizmann Institute: Alteromonas bacteria boost viral killing of microalgae and speed the collapse of blooms, with an effect on the carbon cycle.

scenes.narration: An algal bloom that covers kilometers of sea collapses all at once. And viruses, on their own, cannot fully explain it.

scenes.narration: The result: bacteria significantly increased the algal death caused by the virus. It was not an attack, but a co-infection.

scenes.narration: To measure it they created two indices: a synergy index, which measures the strength of that alliance, and a benefit index, which measures how much the bacterium gains.
